name: State Machine Automated Transition
description: Automatically applies State Machine transitions (e.g. time/condition-based state changes).
project_description:
The State Machine Automated Transition module allows automatic state transitions (chained transition) in state_machine controlled workflows. It provides a configuration interface to select which transitions should be applied automatically, streamlining entity state management. Transitions will only be applied automatically if the corresponding guards allow it.

 Features 
 
 Automated State Transitions – Configurable automatic transitions for entities using the State Machine module. 
 Configuration UI – Admin interface to list workflows and transitions, allowing users to select which should be applied automatically. 
 Transition Orchestrator – On entity update, the module checks for applicable transitions and applies the first valid one. 
 Simple Handling of Multiple Matches – If multiple transitions are found, the module selects the first applicable one for simplicity. 
 
 Use Cases 
 
 Moving orders to the next status in a custom e-commerce workflow. 
 Automatically closing support tickets after a response is marked as resolved. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 
 Install and enable the module. 
 Navigate to the configuration page ( /admin/config/system/automated-transition-settings ). 
 Select workflows and transitions that should be applied automatically. 
 Save the configuration, and the module will handle transitions on entity updates. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 State Machine module
